name: Signal-reception qualifier
summary: A reception qualifier identifies the receiving role of a signal interface.
description: A reception qualifier identifies the receiving role of a signal interface. Reception identifies the destination role of the represented signal relationship. It does not describe how the receiver is powered or what subsequent control action occurs.
Label the received signal and its source. Where one receiver participates in several control functions, use circuit references to connect the shared input to those functions.
readingNotes: Label the incoming signal and the supplying transmitter or source.
Receiving a signal is distinct from supplying electrical power to the interface.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.

distinction: Receiving a signal is distinct from supplying electrical power to the interface.
